modpackUpdate.title: Modpack update
modpackUpdate.upToDate: This modpack is up to date (version {{version}}).
modpackUpdate.currentMissing: The installed version is no longer listed on Modrinth.
modpackUpdate.currentMissingChoose: The installed version is no longer listed on Modrinth, so every version of this pack is shown. Choose carefully: an older version is not refused.

unmanaged.noLock: This instance has no online modpack lock file, so it cannot be updated. Reinstall the pack from Discover to enable updates.
unmanaged.legacyLock: This instance uses an older modpack lock format, so it cannot be updated. Reinstall the pack from Discover to enable updates.
unmanaged.noSource: This instance's modpack lock does not record its Modrinth source, so it cannot be updated. Reinstall the pack from Discover to enable updates.
unmanaged.invalidLock: This instance's modpack lock file cannot be read, so it cannot be updated.

modpackUpdate.applied: Updated to version {{version}}; the previous state was backed up.
modpackUpdate.previousKept: Files changed while the update ran, so the old folder was kept:
modpackUpdate.interrupted: A modpack update was interrupted. Recover it before restoring a backup or updating again.
modpackUpdate.recoverConfirm: Undo the interrupted modpack update of "{{name}}" and reinstate its original directory once the copies are verified?
modpackUpdate.recovered: The interrupted modpack update was undone; the instance is as it was before the update.
modpackUpdate.recoveryRequired: The modpack update did not finish. Keep the listed directories and use the recovery action in the backups section.
modpackUpdate.rolledBack: The modpack update could not finish. The original directory was restored.

plan.title: Update plan
plan.droppedIntents: These files were disabled or deleted before, but the new version no longer contains them:
plan.kept: The new version does not change these files, so your changes to them are kept:
plan.optionalRemoved: These files are optional in the new version and will be removed because optional files are not included. Tick "Include optional files" and show the plan again to keep them:
plan.skipped: {{count}} paths are left alone on purpose (saves, logs, screenshots, launcher files).
plan.conflictHint: Conflicts keep your file unless you choose to use the new version.

conflictReason.userModifiedRemovedUpstream: You modified this file, but the new version no longer includes it.

plan.confirm: Apply this modpack update? An automatic backup is made first.
plan.regenerated: Files changed after the plan was shown. A new plan was made; review it before applying.

notice.resourceRecovered: The interrupted resource transaction was recovered.

searchVersionsPlaceholder: Search by name, game version, or loader
recoverTransactionConfirm: Recover "{{name}}"? The launcher will verify the resource copies first and leave them in place if recovery would be unsafe.
backupRestoreConfirm: Restore "{{name}}" from the {{date}} backup? The launcher will back up its current data first.
backupRecoverConfirm: Finish the interrupted restore of "{{name}}" and reinstate its original directory once the copies are verified?
backupRecovered: The interrupted backup restore has been resolved.
backupWarnings: These backups could not be read. Other backups are still available.

backupWarning.wrongInstance: {{file}}: the backup belongs to a different instance.

backupInterrupted: The previous backup restore was interrupted. Recover it before selecting a different backup.
backupPreviousDate: Pre-restore backup: {{date}}. You can select it in the backup list above.

sharePreview.title: Review files before sharing
sharePreview.description: Download references do not include copies of the original files. Review the bundled and excluded files before choosing a destination.

createMetadata.failedPack: Could not load this modpack’s versions.
createMetadata.emptyPack: No versions are available for this modpack.

memory.title: Out of memory
memory.reason: The JVM could not allocate the memory it needed.
memory.firstSuggestion: Adjust this instance’s memory limit and close programs that use a lot of memory.
memory.secondSuggestion: Use 64-bit Java and stay within the available physical memory.

java.title: Java version mismatch
java.reason: This Java version cannot read the game or mod bytecode.
java.firstSuggestion: Use automatic detection to select Java for this game version.
java.secondSuggestion: Check which Java major version the modpack and mods require.

mods.title: Mod dependencies or versions do not match
mods.reason: The loader reported missing dependencies or incompatible mods.
mods.firstSuggestion: Check the Minecraft and loader versions for your installed mods.
mods.secondSuggestion: Install required dependencies or disable recently added mods and try again.

graphics.title: Graphics initialization failed
graphics.reason: The game could not create the required graphics context.
graphics.firstSuggestion: Update the graphics driver and check OpenGL support.
graphics.secondSuggestion: On a laptop, try assigning Java to the dedicated GPU.

directory.title: Game directory access failed
directory.reason: A permissions problem or another process blocked file access.
directory.firstSuggestion: Choose a game directory writable by the current user.
directory.secondSuggestion: Close other game processes using the same instance directory.

unknown.title: Review the log for more details
unknown.reason: No common failure matched. The log excerpt is available below.
unknown.firstSuggestion: Look for Caused by and ERROR near the end of the log.
unknown.secondSuggestion: Back up the instance, then disable recently added content and try again.

empty.title: No logs yet
empty.reason: This game directory does not contain a log or crash report.
empty.firstSuggestion: Start the game once, then return here to analyze its log.
